mapper.select: select distinct * from mp_auth_role where id in (select role from mp_auth_user_role where user = #{userId})

select distinct u.*, group_concat(distinct ou.org separator ',') as orgs, group_concat(distinct ur.role separator ',') as roles from mp_auth_user u left join mp_auth_tenant_user ou on u.id = ou.user left join mp_auth_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user where u.id in (select user from mp_auth_user_role where role = #{roleId}) group by u.id order by -u.update_time, u.username

select tabA.rid roleId, tabR.name roleName, tabA.cnt userCnt from (select role rid, count(user) cnt from mp_auth_user_role group by role) as tabA left join mp_auth_role tabR on tabA.rid = tabR.id order by userCnt desc
